registry_identity_evidence: Installed BetterQuesting item records explicitly use gregtech:gt.blockmachines and Damage fields; enum+loader identifies each selected item damage/meta-tile ID.

common_steam_exhaust.rule: Keep the immediately adjacent block on configured base.getFrontFacing() clear of collision hitboxes; no cover on that exhaust side. Steam venting can damage living entities in that adjacent cube, so keep it out of the operator aisle.
common_steam_exhaust.main_face_rule: Steam fluid input excludes mMainFacing. The GUI/main face and configured exhaust/output face are separate fields.

evidence_refs.claim: Cover/hitbox vent blocking, adjacent block and entity heat-damage check
Steam input excludes mMainFacing
Stores mMainFacing and moves equal base front to its opposite
When main face is known, configured base facing must differ from it
Main face excludes UP and DOWN
